Title: Purview
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/purview
Content: The Solidatus Purview Connector is a Java based tool to transfer lineage and asset data between Purview and Solidatus. At present it supports transferring assets and lineage from connector-created Snowflake and Oracle models in Solidatus into Purview.
Title: Permissions
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/purview/permissions
Content: During the Azure Service Principle creation process you will create a client id and client secret. Make sure to note what that is, as it is required in the connector configuration. The full list of required Purview configuration items is as follows:

Azure Purview API endpoint
https://{your-purview-account}.purview.azure.com
URL of your Purview instance
Azure Purview tenant id
12345678-1abc-2def-ba81-99999999999
Tenant ID of your Purview instance. Can be found in the URL after logging in to the Purview web UI
Azure Purview client id
12345678-1abc-2def-ba81-99999999999
Client ID of the Service Principal you created for access to Purview
Azure Purview client secret
********
The secret created during the creation of the Service Principal
Azure Purview API token scope
https://purview.azure.net/.default
The URI of the resource the token is acquired for, passed as resource to the token request
Azure Purview API collection ID
abcdef
ID of the collection to add/update assets in. If not set will use the default collection

Title: Oracle
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.2/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/purview/oracle
Content: The Solidatus Connector for Purview allows you to push a Solidatus Oracle lineage model, created by the Solidatus
Database (JDBC) Connector into Purview.

The Solidatus Purview Integration for Oracle will find and match existing Oracle database assets in Purview, based on
their Purview Fully Qualified Name (FQN), with Solidatus entities in the Oracle lineage model.

If a matching asset can not be found, then a new Purview Asset is created.

All data lineage from the Solidatus model is pushed to Purview. Any existing lineage between matched oracle assets in
Purview, is over-written.

Any existing Oracle Purview Assets which have related Glossary Terms, where the term has been imported into a
Solidatus Reference Model, will have a Reference Model relationship created in Solidatus on their matched lineage
model entity.
